loci.name: asset-light-structural-defensibility
loci.one_line: Whether asset-light marketplace models possess a permanent structural advantage over 1P inventory distribution or merely substitute logistics losses for platform bypass risk.
loci.rationale: Core foundational architecture of POL. Determines whether POL should ever hold inventory or remain pure software/transaction infrastructure.

loci.name: anti-disintermediation-mechanisms
loci.one_line: Evaluating the empirical validity of anti-bypass mechanisms: multi-vendor cart bundling, embedded bank credit, and wholesaler ERP lock-in.
loci.rationale: Existential survival question. If disintermediation cannot be prevented, asset-light platforms become unmonetizable directories.

loci.name: embedded-credit-default-insulation
loci.one_line: How B2B platforms integrate working capital credit without balance-sheet lending or toxic default exposure in high-inflation emerging markets.
loci.rationale: Determines POL fintech architecture and partnerships with Iranian commercial banks.

loci.name: cart-allocation-dynamic-clustering
loci.one_line: Algorithmic optimization of multi-vendor baskets to maximize price savings while capping physical delivery drops to stores.
loci.rationale: Critical product architecture for supermarket user experience and delivery economics in congested Tehran.

loci.name: phygital-field-force-migration-velocity
loci.one_line: The operational mechanics and incentive structures that migrate traditional store owners from sales-rep dependence to autonomous night ordering.
loci.rationale: Controls POL operational expenditure and customer acquisition payback period.

skip_loci.justification: Premature. Global benchmarks show that attempting B2C quick commerce alongside B2B FMCG procurement dilutes focus and causes heavy burn (e.g. GudangAda, Ula).
